transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this curriculum-approval meeting. As you know, the partner high school has proposed a dual-credit environmental science course for the spring term. The draft proposal lists a maximum enrollment of 28 students, three credits, and Ms. Patel as the instructor, and the course will count toward both the high-school science program and participating students' community-college transcripts. Before I sign off on the approval, I need each of you -- the proposed instructor, the registrar, and the dual-credit liaison -- to report any information that must be reflected in the final approval. Please go ahead.
